statement.p: Evaluate the triple integral of f(x,y,z) = \sin(x^2 + y^2) over the solid cylinder with height 3 and with base of radius 3 centered on the z axis at z = -3.

static.solution: \int_W f\,dV = \int_{-3}^{0} \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{3} (\sin(r^2)\, r\, dr\,d\theta\,dz. Integrating, \int_{-3}^{0} \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{3} (\sin(r^2)\, r\, dr\,d\theta\,dz = \int_{-3}^{0} \int_0^{2\pi} \frac12\cdot-\cos(r^2) \bigg|_{r=0}^{r=3}\,d\theta\,dz = \int_{-3}^{0} \int_0^{2\pi} \frac12(1 - \cos(9))\,d\theta\,dz. \frac12(1 - \cos(9))\int_{-3}^{0} 2\pi\,dz = 3\pi(1 - \cos(9)).
